flags.description: Compares total row counts between model and reference outputs.
flags.sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

flags.description: Compares distinct customer_id counts to catch duplicate or missing keys.
flags.sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

flags.description: Compares grand total lifetime_revenue across all customers.
flags.sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

flags.description: Compares grand total lifetime_orders across all customers.
flags.sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_orders) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_orders) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

flags.description: Compares the revenue-weighted average order value (sum revenue / sum orders) at the grand total level.
flags.sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue)/NULLIF(SUM(lifetime_orders),0) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(lifetime_revenue)/NULLIF(SUM(lifetime_orders),0) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

flags.description: Compares the simple (unweighted) average of per-customer avg_order_supply_cost, ignoring customers with no item records.
flags.sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT AVG(avg_order_supply_cost) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT AVG(avg_order_supply_cost) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

flags.description: Flags customer_id keys present in one table but missing from the other.
flags.sql: SELECT 'in_model_not_reference' AS slice, COUNT(*) AS model_value, 0 AS reference_value FROM model_output m LEFT JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE r.customer_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'in_reference_not_model' AS slice, 0 AS model_value, COUNT(*) AS reference_value FROM reference_output r LEFT JOIN model_output m ON r.customer_id = m.customer_id WHERE m.customer_id IS NULL

flags.description: Compares lifetime_revenue per customer_id, catching duplicate-key fan-out via SUM.
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

flags.description: Compares lifetime_orders per customer_id, catching duplicate-key fan-out via SUM.
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(lifetime_orders) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(lifetime_orders) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

flags.description: Compares avg_order_value per customer_id.
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(avg_order_value) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(avg_order_value) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

flags.description: Compares avg_order_supply_cost per customer_id, sensitive to incorrect exclusion/inclusion of orders without item records.
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(avg_order_supply_cost) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(avg_order_supply_cost) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

flags.description: Compares first_order_date (as epoch days) per customer_id.
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(first_order_date) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(first_order_date) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, CAST(m.val - DATE '1970-01-01' AS BIGINT) AS model_value, CAST(r.val - DATE '1970-01-01' AS BIGINT) AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

flags.description: Compares last_order_date (as epoch days) per customer_id.
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(last_order_date) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(last_order_date) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.customer_id, r.customer_id) AS slice, CAST(m.val - DATE '1970-01-01' AS BIGINT) AS model_value, CAST(r.val - DATE '1970-01-01' AS BIGINT) AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id

flags.description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by year of first_order_date.
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date, '%Y') AS yr, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date, '%Y') AS yr, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.yr, r.yr) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr

flags.description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by year-month of first_order_date.
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS mo, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS mo, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.mo, r.mo) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.mo = r.mo

flags.description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by year-quarter of first_order_date.
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date,'%Y') || '-Q' || CAST(((EXTRACT(month FROM first_order_date)-1)/3+1) AS INT) AS q, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date,'%Y') || '-Q' || CAST(((EXTRACT(month FROM first_order_date)-1)/3+1) AS INT) AS q, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.q, r.q) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.q = r.q

flags.description: Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by year of last_order_date.
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(last_order_date, '%Y') AS yr, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT strftime(last_order_date, '%Y') AS yr, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.yr, r.yr) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr

flags.description: Compares total lifetime_orders grouped by year-month of last_order_date.
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS mo, SUM(lifetime_orders) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS mo, SUM(lifetime_orders) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.mo, r.mo) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.mo = r.mo

flags.description: Compares customer counts on the earliest first_order_date (per reference) to check boundary handling.
flags.sql: WITH ref_min AS (SELECT MIN(first_order_date) AS d FROM reference_output) SELECT 'first_order_date_min=' || CAST(d AS VARCHAR) AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE first_order_date = ref_min.d) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE first_order_date = ref_min.d) AS reference_value FROM ref_min

flags.description: Compares customer counts on the latest last_order_date (per reference) to check boundary handling.
flags.sql: WITH ref_max AS (SELECT MAX(last_order_date) AS d FROM reference_output) SELECT 'last_order_date_max=' || CAST(d AS VARCHAR) AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE last_order_date = ref_max.d) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE last_order_date = ref_max.d) AS reference_value FROM ref_max

flags.description: Compares summed avg_order_value for one-order customers, an edge case for the avg_order_value formula.
flags.sql: SELECT 'lifetime_orders=1' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(avg_order_value) FROM model_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 1) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(avg_order_value) FROM reference_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 1) AS reference_value

flags.description: Compares the count of customers with a null avg_order_supply_cost, testing correct exclusion of customers with no item records.
flags.sql: SELECT 'null_avg_order_supply_cost' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NULL) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NULL) AS reference_value

flags.description: Compares customer counts across lifetime_orders buckets (1, 2-3, 4-10, 11+).
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders=1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-3' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN '4-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders=1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-3' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN '4-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.bucket, r.bucket) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.bucket = r.bucket

flags.description: Compares total lifetime_revenue across lifetime_orders buckets (1, 2-3, 4-10, 11+).
flags.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders=1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-3' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN '4-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders=1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-3' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN '4-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.bucket, r.bucket) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.bucket = r.bucket

flags.description: Counts customer_id keys present in both tables whose customer_name differs; expected to be zero.
flags.sql: SELECT 'name_mismatch_count' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output m JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE m.customer_name IS DISTINCT FROM r.customer_name) AS model_value, 0 AS reference_value

flags.description: Compares min/max first_order_date and last_order_date (as epoch days) between model and reference.
flags.sql: SELECT 'min_first_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT MIN(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MIN(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM reference_output) AS reference_value UNION ALL SELECT 'max_first_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT MAX(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MAX(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM reference_output) AS reference_value UNION ALL SELECT 'min_last_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT MIN(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MIN(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM reference_output) AS reference_value UNION ALL SELECT 'max_last_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT MAX(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MAX(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

flags.description: Compares the count of customers with lifetime_revenue <= 0, an unexpected edge case given qualifying-order filters.
flags.sql: SELECT 'revenue_lte_0' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE lifetime_revenue <= 0) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE lifetime_revenue <= 0) AS reference_value

flags.description: Compares total lifetime_revenue by week of last_order_date for the most recent 8 weeks (per reference max date), testing recency edge handling.
flags.sql: WITH ref_max AS (SELECT MAX(last_order_date) AS d FROM reference_output), m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', last_order_date) AS wk, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM model_output, ref_max WHERE last_order_date > ref_max.d - INTERVAL 56 DAY GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', last_order_date) AS wk, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM reference_output, ref_max WHERE last_order_date > ref_max.d - INTERVAL 56 DAY GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.wk AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.wk AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.wk = r.wk

flags.description: Compares the count of rows where stored avg_order_value deviates from recomputed lifetime_revenue/lifetime_orders by more than a small epsilon.
flags.sql: SELECT 'avg_order_value_inconsistent_rows' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE ABS(avg_order_value - lifetime_revenue / NULLIF(lifetime_orders, 0)) > 0.01) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE ABS(avg_order_value - lifetime_revenue / NULLIF(lifetime_orders, 0)) > 0.01) AS reference_value

flags.description: Compares a weighted total proxy (sum of avg_order_supply_cost times lifetime_orders) to surface systematic supply-cost averaging errors.
flags.sql: SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(avg_order_supply_cost * lifetime_orders) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(avg_order_supply_cost * lifetime_orders) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value

ai.prompt:
A dbt model has been changed and must be reconciled against an independent reference dashboard before it ships.

## Model: customer_lifetime_value

### Business definition (from the model's YAML)
Lifetime value per customer. One row per real customer with at least one qualifying order (internal "QA Test Account" customers and refunded orders are excluded). lifetime_revenue is the sum of qualifying order totals including tax. avg_order_value is lifetime_revenue / lifetime_orders. avg_order_supply_cost is the mean supply cost over qualifying orders that have item records; orders with no item records are excluded from the average rather than counted as zero.

### Model SQL (dbt/Jinja, DuckDB dialect)
```sql
with

orders as (

    select * from {{ ref('orders') }}

),

customers as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_customers') }}

),

refunds as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_refunds') }}

),

qualifying_orders as (

    select
        orders.*,
        customers.customer_name

    from orders

    inner join customers
        on orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id

    left join refunds
        on orders.order_id = refunds.order_id

    where not customers.is_test_account

)

select
    qualifying_orders.customer_id,
    qualifying_orders.customer_name,
    cast(min(qualifying_orders.ordered_at_ts) as date) as first_order_date,
    cast(max(qualifying_orders.ordered_at_ts) as date) as last_order_date,
    cast(count(qualifying_orders.order_id) as bigint) as lifetime_orders,
    cast(sum(qualifying_orders.order_total) as decimal(18, 2)) as lifetime_revenue,
    cast(sum(qualifying_orders.order_total) as double)
        / count(qualifying_orders.order_id) as avg_order_value,
    cast(avg(qualifying_orders.order_cost) as double) as avg_order_supply_cost

from qualifying_orders

group by 1, 2
```

## Tables available to your queries
Your queries run in a sandbox that contains exactly two tables and nothing else:

`model_output`: the model's output.
  - customer_id: VARCHAR
  - customer_name: VARCHAR
  - first_order_date: DATE
  - last_order_date: DATE
  - lifetime_orders: BIGINT
  - lifetime_revenue: DECIMAL(18,2)
  - avg_order_value: DOUBLE
  - avg_order_supply_cost: DOUBLE

`reference_output`: the trusted reference dashboard, computed independently from raw data at the same grain.
  - customer_id: VARCHAR
  - customer_name: VARCHAR
  - first_order_date: DATE
  - last_order_date: DATE
  - lifetime_orders: BIGINT
  - lifetime_revenue: DOUBLE
  - avg_order_value: DOUBLE
  - avg_order_supply_cost: DOUBLE

Grain (one row per): customer_id

## Task
Write up to 40 reconciliation queries comparing `model_output` to `reference_output`. Choose slices that would expose wrong numbers that still pass schema checks and data tests, for example: grand totals of each measure; totals by each dimension and dimension member; each available time grain (day, week, month, as applicable); edge periods (first/last periods, period boundaries); row counts and key coverage (keys present in one table but not the other); and averages/ratios where nulls or join fan-out could distort them.

Each query MUST return exactly these columns:
- `slice` (varchar): a human-readable label for the row, e.g. 'total', '2025-03 | Brooklyn'
- `model_value` (numeric): the value computed from model_output
- `reference_value` (numeric): the same value computed from reference_output

A query may return one row (a total) or many rows (one per slice). Use a full outer join on the slice keys so that slices missing on either side appear, with NULL on the missing side. Do not compute differences yourself; the harness compares model_value to reference_value. Return at most 5000 rows per query.

Respond with only this JSON object:
{"queries": [{"id": "short_snake_case_id", "kind": "total|dimension|time_grain|edge|coverage|ratio", "measure": "<column compared, or row_count>", "dimensions": ["<columns sliced by>"], "time_grain": "none|day|week|month|quarter|year", "description": "<one sentence>", "sql": "<DuckDB SQL>"}]}

{"id": "quarter_first_order_revenue", "kind": "time_grain", "measure": "lifetime_revenue", "dimensions": ["first_order_date"], "time_grain": "quarter", "description": "Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by year-quarter of first_order_date.", "sql": "WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date,'%Y') || '-Q' || CAST(((EXTRACT(month FROM first_order_date)-1)/3+1) AS INT) AS q, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT strftime(first_order_date,'%Y') || '-Q' || CAST(((EXTRACT(month FROM first_order_date)-1)/3+1) AS INT) AS q, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.q, r.q) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.q = r.q"},
{"id": "year_last_order_revenue", "kind": "time_grain", "measure": "lifetime_revenue", "dimensions": ["last_order_date"], "time_grain": "year", "description": "Compares total lifetime_revenue grouped by year of last_order_date.", "sql": "WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(last_order_date, '%Y') AS yr, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT strftime(last_order_date, '%Y') AS yr, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.yr, r.yr) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.yr = r.yr"},
{"id": "month_last_order_orders", "kind": "time_grain", "measure": "lifetime_orders", "dimensions": ["last_order_date"], "time_grain": "month", "description": "Compares total lifetime_orders grouped by year-month of last_order_date.", "sql": "WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS mo, SUM(lifetime_orders) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT strftime(last_order_date, '%Y-%m') AS mo, SUM(lifetime_orders) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.mo, r.mo) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.mo = r.mo"},
{"id": "edge_min_first_order_date_count", "kind": "edge", "measure": "row_count", "dimensions": ["first_order_date"], "time_grain": "day", "description": "Compares customer counts on the earliest first_order_date (per reference) to check boundary handling.", "sql": "WITH ref_min AS (SELECT MIN(first_order_date) AS d FROM reference_output) SELECT 'first_order_date_min=' || CAST(d AS VARCHAR) AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE first_order_date = ref_min.d) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE first_order_date = ref_min.d) AS reference_value FROM ref_min"},
{"id": "edge_max_last_order_date_count", "kind": "edge", "measure": "row_count", "dimensions": ["last_order_date"], "time_grain": "day", "description": "Compares customer counts on the latest last_order_date (per reference) to check boundary handling.", "sql": "WITH ref_max AS (SELECT MAX(last_order_date) AS d FROM reference_output) SELECT 'last_order_date_max=' || CAST(d AS VARCHAR) AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE last_order_date = ref_max.d) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE last_order_date = ref_max.d) AS reference_value FROM ref_max"},
{"id": "edge_single_order_customers_avg_value", "kind": "edge", "measure": "avg_order_value", "dimensions": ["lifetime_orders"], "time_grain": "none", "description": "Compares summed avg_order_value for one-order customers, an edge case for the avg_order_value formula.", "sql": "SELECT 'lifetime_orders=1' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(avg_order_value) FROM model_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 1) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(avg_order_value) FROM reference_output WHERE lifetime_orders = 1) AS reference_value"},
{"id": "null_avg_order_supply_cost_count", "kind": "edge", "measure": "row_count", "dimensions": [], "time_grain": "none", "description": "Compares the count of customers with a null avg_order_supply_cost, testing correct exclusion of customers with no item records.", "sql": "SELECT 'null_avg_order_supply_cost' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NULL) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE avg_order_supply_cost IS NULL) AS reference_value"},
{"id": "lifetime_orders_bucket_distribution_count", "kind": "dimension", "measure": "row_count", "dimensions": ["lifetime_orders"], "time_grain": "none", "description": "Compares customer counts across lifetime_orders buckets (1, 2-3, 4-10, 11+).", "sql": "WITH m AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders=1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-3' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN '4-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders=1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-3' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN '4-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.bucket, r.bucket) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.bucket = r.bucket"},
{"id": "lifetime_orders_bucket_distribution_revenue", "kind": "dimension", "measure": "lifetime_revenue", "dimensions": ["lifetime_orders"], "time_grain": "none", "description": "Compares total lifetime_revenue across lifetime_orders buckets (1, 2-3, 4-10, 11+).", "sql": "WITH m AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders=1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-3' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN '4-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM model_output GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT CASE WHEN lifetime_orders=1 THEN '1' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-3' WHEN lifetime_orders BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN '4-10' ELSE '11+' END AS bucket, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM reference_output GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(m.bucket, r.bucket) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.bucket = r.bucket"},
{"id": "customer_name_mismatch_count", "kind": "coverage", "measure": "row_count", "dimensions": ["customer_id", "customer_name"], "time_grain": "none", "description": "Counts customer_id keys present in both tables whose customer_name differs; expected to be zero.", "sql": "SELECT 'name_mismatch_count' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output m JOIN reference_output r ON m.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE m.customer_name IS DISTINCT FROM r.customer_name) AS model_value, 0 AS reference_value"},
{"id": "date_range_min_max", "kind": "edge", "measure": "date_epoch_days", "dimensions": ["first_order_date", "last_order_date"], "time_grain": "day", "description": "Compares min/max first_order_date and last_order_date (as epoch days) between model and reference.", "sql": "SELECT 'min_first_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT MIN(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MIN(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM reference_output) AS reference_value UNION ALL SELECT 'max_first_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT MAX(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MAX(first_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM reference_output) AS reference_value UNION ALL SELECT 'min_last_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT MIN(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MIN(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM reference_output) AS reference_value UNION ALL SELECT 'max_last_order_date' AS slice, (SELECT MAX(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT MAX(last_order_date) - DATE '1970-01-01' FROM reference_output) AS reference_value"},
{"id": "total_customers_zero_or_negative_revenue", "kind": "edge", "measure": "row_count", "dimensions": [], "time_grain": "none", "description": "Compares the count of customers with lifetime_revenue <= 0, an unexpected edge case given qualifying-order filters.", "sql": "SELECT 'revenue_lte_0' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE lifetime_revenue <= 0) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE lifetime_revenue <= 0) AS reference_value"},
{"id": "recent_week_last_order_revenue", "kind": "time_grain", "measure": "lifetime_revenue", "dimensions": ["last_order_date"], "time_grain": "week", "description": "Compares total lifetime_revenue by week of last_order_date for the most recent 8 weeks (per reference max date), testing recency edge handling.", "sql": "WITH ref_max AS (SELECT MAX(last_order_date) AS d FROM reference_output), m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', last_order_date) AS wk, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM model_output, ref_max WHERE last_order_date > ref_max.d - INTERVAL 56 DAY GROUP BY 1), r AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', last_order_date) AS wk, SUM(lifetime_revenue) AS val FROM reference_output, ref_max WHERE last_order_date > ref_max.d - INTERVAL 56 DAY GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(m.wk AS VARCHAR), CAST(r.wk AS VARCHAR)) AS slice, m.val AS model_value, r.val AS reference_value FROM m FULL OUTER JOIN r ON m.wk = r.wk"},
{"id": "avg_order_value_recompute_consistency", "kind": "ratio", "measure": "avg_order_value", "dimensions": [], "time_grain": "none", "description": "Compares the count of rows where stored avg_order_value deviates from recomputed lifetime_revenue/lifetime_orders by more than a small epsilon.", "sql": "SELECT 'avg_order_value_inconsistent_rows' AS slice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_output WHERE ABS(avg_order_value - lifetime_revenue / NULLIF(lifetime_orders, 0)) > 0.01) AS model_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_output WHERE ABS(avg_order_value - lifetime_revenue / NULLIF(lifetime_orders, 0)) > 0.01) AS reference_value"},
{"id": "avg_order_supply_cost_weighted_total_proxy", "kind": "ratio", "measure": "avg_order_supply_cost", "dimensions": [], "time_grain": "none", "description": "Compares a weighted total proxy (sum of avg_order_supply_cost times lifetime_orders) to surface systematic supply-cost averaging errors.", "sql": "SELECT 'total' AS slice, (SELECT SUM(avg_order_supply_cost * lifetime_orders) FROM model_output) AS model_value, (SELECT SUM(avg_order_supply_cost * lifetime_orders) FROM reference_output) AS reference_value"}
]}
